scope: Initial complete public ordinary/where contextual run plus exactly six corrected universe-fixture cells. Exact displayed terms, source types, owner observations and finite dictionary-payload behavior were independently checked; no complete public or global/universe-support claim.

composite.interpretation: Offline combination of two disjoint selected outcomes. This is not a fresh 39-cell rerun; the original six fixture failures and four production timeouts remain recorded below.

review.mode: Read/hash-only receipt and capture verification; no synthesis, compiler, kernel or tests rerun.
review.command_input_relation: Prepared commands use LF; the existing Windows process helper captures stdin using CRLF. Both raw hashes are preserved and the decoded texts match after only CRLF-to-LF normalization.
review.scope: Source manifests verified against their preserved before/after boundaries; runtime bytes rehashed. The runner fixture was corrected between runs, not relabeled as identical source.

original_source_types.forwarding: (∀ (β : Type), [ContextProduction.Dictionary β] → β → ContextProduction.Token) → (∀ (β : Type), [ContextProduction.Dictionary β] → β → ContextProduction.Token)
original_source_types.local_given: ∀ (α : Type), [ContextProduction.Dictionary α] → (∀ (β : Type), [ContextProduction.Dictionary β] → β → ContextProduction.Token) → α → ContextProduction.Token

preserved_failures: Four ordinary forwarding/local_given cases in Exference/Both report the original 45-second command timeout with no displayed output. Their live processes completed, not process-guard timeouts.
Six initial constant_universe cases never ran live because their shared syntax preflight incorrectly expected Type from a Prop-valued class. Its oracle preflight passed.

The follow-up adds only an explicit Type result sort to that fixture class. It passes syntax/oracle checks and all six explicit metadata-refusal cells; no runtime production source or setting changed.
